title: Northgate Credit Cards Reward Certificate Terms Schedule
content:
The rewards earned on a Northgate Credit Cards account in a reward year are converted into a card reward certificate. This schedule gives the certificate figures and settings for each card product: the month in which it is issued, the month at whose end it expires, the smallest reward-year balance that is issued, and the settings for redemption, reissue and restriction.

## Terms table

| Term | Northgate Store Card | Northgate Business Store Card | Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | Northgate Rewards Visa Business | Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Issue month (calendar month after the reward year in which the certificate is issued) | 2 (February) | 2 (February) | 2 (February) | 2 (February) | 2 (February) | 2 (February) |
| Expiry month (calendar month of the issue year at whose end the certificate expires) | 12 (December) | 12 (December) | 12 (December) | 12 (December) | 12 (December) | 12 (December) |
| Smallest reward-year balance issued as a certificate (a smaller balance is carried into the next year) | $1.00 | $1.00 | $1.00 | $1.00 | $1.00 | $1.00 |
| Redeemable only while the linked membership is active | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| May be taken in cash at a club register | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Must be redeemed in one transaction | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Times a lost certificate may be reissued | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| A certificate due while the card is restricted is held until the card is active again | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Every figure and setting is the same on all six card products.

## Calendar illustration (hypothetical reward year)

| Event | Timing for a hypothetical reward year 2025 |
|---|---|
| Reward year | The January 2025 through December 2025 statements |
| Certificate issued | With the statement closing in February 2026 (month 2 of the following year) |
| Certificate expires | At the end of December 2026 (month 12 of the issue year) |

## Balance illustration (hypothetical balances)

- A reward-year balance of $1.00 is not smaller than the $1.00 figure and is issued as a certificate.
- A reward-year balance of $0.99 is smaller than $1.00 and is carried into the next year.
